description: THE BEST TEAM OF THE WORLD
summary: Our project is an interactive space mission simulation game where players design and manage their own space missions. They choose a destination, spacecraft, scientific instruments, and launch vehicle while managing resources such as budget, energy, mass, communications, and time. Players must make strategic decisions, solve unexpected problems, and complete their mission without exceeding their limits. The game can be played individually or in teams and helps develop teamwork, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making skills while teaching how real space missions work.
details:
Our project is an interactive space mission simulation game that allows players to experience the process of planning and managing a space mission.

First, players choose a mission destination, such as Mars, the Moon, or an asteroid. Then, they design their spacecraft by selecting its type, scientific instruments, launch vehicle, orbit, and mission duration.

Throughout the game, players must manage five important resources: budget, mass, power, communications, and time. Each decision has advantages and disadvantages. For example, choosing advanced scientific instruments can provide more information but may increase costs and energy consumption.

Players must follow the game rules, stay within their available resources, and solve unexpected events such as communication problems, system failures, or low energy.

The game can be played individually or in teams of up to four members, with each person having a different responsibility. At the end, players receive points based on their mission objectives, resource management, scientific results, and overall performance.

The main purpose is to teach players how space missions work while developing teamwork, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
